description: Send build events to a URL. Slack and Discord webhook URLs are detected and formatted as chat messages. Events: build.published, standing_link.updated, build.expiring, build.file_missing, tester.installed.

events.description: Events to send. Defaults to everything except tester.installed.

format.description: Omit to detect from the URL.

url.description: https URL, or a Slack/Discord incoming webhook URL.

name: betadrop_create_webhook
